course.title: Social Stratification and Inequality

outcomes.LO1: Compare and apply the major theories of stratification (Marx, Weber, Bourdieu)
outcomes.LO2: Distinguish class, status, wealth, and income, and use them precisely
outcomes.LO3: Analyse how stratification is reproduced across generations
outcomes.LO4: Explain the intersections of class with race and gender
outcomes.LO5: Evaluate empirical measures of inequality against their limits
outcomes.LO6: Argue a causal account of a stratification outcome with evidence

core_readings: Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels, The Communist Manifesto (1848)
